criteria.input_representation: exact f32 or BF16 words, independently frozen; compare represented values, no candidate-derived expected input
criteria.oracle: stdlib f64 math.fsum/exp; no MLX/matmul/candidate selector; 2e-12 reference slack
criteria.error_equations: gamma_H*sum(abs(x*w)); sigmoid 16u+0.25*projection_error+2e-12, u=2^-24. Bias-add rounding added to ranking error. Normalization denominator bound K*sigmoid_error+gamma_K*(S+K*sigmoid_error), propagated with S-dS>0 and division/multiply roundoff. Per-case bounds frozen.
criteria.selection: exact selected IDs as a set plus per-ID scores; argpartition order unspecified; retain raw order
criteria.finite_domain: all values finite, |x| and |weight|<=4; H<=16 E<=288 B<=2 T<=5; arrays<=1MiB
criteria.cache_reset: fresh selector/class function objects per normal/mutant/restored step, retained alive to reject identity reuse; no cold native-cache claim
criteria.top_k1: normalization intentionally bypassed by unchanged selector
criteria.scope: grouped-negative exclusion and entire model remain unqualified

precision_discriminator.alternative: independent scalar projection then BF16 RNE before sigmoid; predicts omitted-both-casts behavior if native BF16 matmul returns BF16
precision_discriminator.individual_omission_policy: A remaining FP32 operand may trigger native promotion. Record actual numerical nondiscrimination as a coverage gap; do not count it as intended detection.
precision_discriminator.both_omitted_policy: Only qualified as discriminating if actual supported native operation reaches the caller/selector and violates the frozen output criterion; unsupported native operation is a separate control domain.

dtype_admission: FP32 CPU/Metal smoke first; BF16 conversion case attempts within matrix are independently classified. Unsupported BF16 does not discard FP32.
